movie.title: Do Not Enter
movie.overview: A group of young explorers investigates an old abandoned hotel, only to encounter a strange supernatural being and a competing group looking for a legendary hidden treasure.

reviews.author: Gordon
reviews.content:
This movie would make a GREAT survival horror game.

The movie itself was really good, it had solid acting and it didn't seem to rely on jump scares. The story was good and fleshed out and the things they didn't reveal, they explained in good time.
Not too gory and was a great balance of horror and story telling.

I would recommend this movie to anyone who likes story driven horror films.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content:
This is not Ghost Ship
I think this movie wanted to be Ghost Ship, or at least as good as Ghost Ship. It didn't reach there. The characters were engaging enough and the direction solid, but the look of the movie wasn't grand, and the monster just looked floaty and unrealistic, given how it was rendered into the scenes. It just wasn't believable, had no agenda, and no reason. It was just a "scary thing" skulking about.

reviews.author: GregLikesMovies
reviews.content: Cinematography, editing, acting, special effects, production design, all of it good. Its just too bad the script is at times embarrassingly juvenile; with cringeworthy dialog and wafer thin characters who act without rhyme or reason. A bad movie wrapped in a pretty package. Not recommended for those of average wit or above.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a group of young urban explorers ventures into an eerie abandoned hotel, they find themselves caught between a terrifying supernatural entity and a ruthless rival team searching for a legendary hidden treasure.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A team of brave young explorers decides to investigate a mysterious, long-abandoned hotel in search of answers about its dark past. Shortly after stepping inside, they realize they are not alone as a sinister supernatural presence haunts the decaying corridors. To make matters worse, a ruthless competing group of treasure hunters has also infiltrated the premises to claim a legendary hidden fortune. Caught between paranormal terror and human greed, the explorers must put aside their differences and fight to survive the night.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Driven by curiosity and a passion for urban exploration, a close-knit group of young friends sets out to investigate a long-abandoned hotel shrouded in ominous local legends. What begins as an exciting late-night adventure quickly takes a harrowing turn as strange, unexplainable phenomena begin manifesting throughout the rotting halls. Shadows seem to move on their own, whispers echo through empty stairwells, and an ancient, hostile supernatural entity awakens to defend its territory. As terror takes hold, the group attempts to flee, only to discover that all exits have been mysteriously sealed off by the vengeful spirit. While trying to find an alternative escape route, they unexpectedly cross paths with another group of trespassers who have broken into the hotel for a completely different reason. This rival crew is desperately seeking a priceless, legendary treasure rumored to be concealed deep within the building's labyrinthine basement. Tensions explode between the two factions as mistrust and panic escalate under the constant threat of the entity picking them off one by one. Realizing that the supernatural force feeds on their fear and division, the young explorers are forced to confront both their personal demons and their hostile rivals. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the survivors must navigate treacherous traps, dark secrets buried in the hotel's tragic history, and relentless paranormal attacks. Ultimately, they must choose between pursuing the elusive fortune or abandoning everything to escape the nightmare alive before the entity claims them forever.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Do Not Enter is a dark horror-drama that follows a group of adventurous young urban explorers who step past forbidden boundaries to investigate an abandoned, decrepit hotel steeped in sinister folklore. Expecting nothing more than dusty history and thrilling atmosphere, the team is quickly thrust into a living nightmare when they awaken an ancient, vengeful supernatural entity that traps them within the decaying walls. As fear and paranoia set in, their struggle for survival becomes even more dangerous when they encounter a hardened rival group hunting for a legendary treasure hidden in the hotel's depths. Blending eerie supernatural terror with intense human drama, the story explores themes of fear, greed, loyalty, and the dangerous lengths people will go to uncover the unknown.
